name: base_mask
description: A mask: a shell off the front of the face. The y_max bound is what makes it a mask and not a hood, and it sits well forward of the middle of the head on purpose -- a cut plane through the centre runs almost parallel to the surface of the cheeks, and a cut that grazes a surface shreds it. Forward of the brow the face meets the plane closer to square and the edge comes out clean. The bases face -Y, so the face is the negative side.
